name: Georgette Leigh
source: The protagonist’s lady’s maid/gentleman’s gentleman. They have served the protagonist for the past decade, indulging their every wish and whim to the best of their ability. They have harbored feelings for their master for some time now, though they’ve endeavored to keep them hidden. They assist their master in everything, including helping them try and win Heron’s affection...despite the fact it kills their heart to do so.
